answer: A concrete defense is bonded identity: every agent must lock a full collateral deposit to register as a distinct actor, and each identity consumes one whole bond. An attacker spinning up a thousand sybils must therefore fork over a thousand deposits at once, while slashing burns the stake of any account caught colluding. The reward pool flows like nectar only to identities that clear this bar, so fakes cannot siphon value. Reputation climbs a vine of attested interactions, and every verified key is minted as one onyx token that cannot be split or merged.
